name: multi-time-step solution method
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 对不同子系统采用不同时间步长并协调求解的方法。

complete_examples.text: Besides, a multi-time-step solution method is presented to improve the computational efficiency and obtaining a convergent solution for VTS systems.
To validate the effectiveness of the multi-time-step solution method, examples for solving VTS interaction are presented.
